本次更新重点优化手机端打开番剧详情和返回的体验，新增本地字体导入，并更新四个内置播放源。

### 界面与交互

- **优化番剧详情转场。** 点击卡片后，圆角小窗口从封面位置逐渐铺满全屏，返回时收回卡片。适配 Android 预测性返回和 iOS 侧滑返回手势。
- **支持导入自定义字体。** 在「设置 → 外观 → 导入字体」选择本地 `.ttf` 或 `.otf` 文件，重启应用后会恢复已导入的字体。
- **调整移动端底部导航。** 优化拖动切换和随滚动收起、显示的交互。社区发帖按钮随底栏一同收起。

### 性能优化/修复

- 优化 Android 首页触摸采样和海报网格绘制，减轻慢速滚动时的细节抖动。
- 减少封面加载、详情刷新和播放选源时的重复处理。内存紧张时释放部分后台标签页。
- 修复ios和macos异常播放器黑屏的问题。

### 播放

- 修复部分 HLS 视频因上游返回重复响应头而无法正常读取分片的问题。

### 平台兼容

- 统一 Android 各架构安装包的版本号，避免同一版本因架构不同而被识别为不同构建。
- 同步 iOS 和 macOS 的媒体库与播放器渲染插件版本，并更新 Windows 打包流程以兼容六位构建号。

apps.name: Apollo for Reddit - GLASS
apps.subtitle: Apollo-Reborn build with Liquid Glass patch
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Features

- Add a **Subreddit Switcher** choice of **Classic** or **Modern** under Interface → Display & Navigation: Classic brings back Apollo's original Favorites popup for title taps and Posts tab holds, and Modern keeps the search sheet (#1604: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Classic is the default on regular iPhones, so updating from 4.0.x brings the popup back; Modern is the default on iPhone Duo
  - Modern now opens with the keyboard up and starts loading your pick right away, and on the iPhone Duo holding the Posts tab opens the switcher from the side rail and when unfolded
- Add **Jump Button Navigation** so the comment jump button can step through comments posted since your last visit instead of top-level threads; press and hold to go back one (#1506: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Choose Threads (default) or New Comments under Settings → General below Jump Button Position, or from a post's ••• menu; the button shows a NEW label in that mode
- Add **Tint Tab Bar Icons** to give unselected tab icons a muted shade of your theme's accent, on the classic and Liquid Glass tab bars and the iPhone Duo side rail (#1684: @IllIIllIllIllII, @AcornElf)
  - Add **Accent Navigation Buttons** on Liquid Glass to draw Back, toolbar and menu buttons in your theme's accent; titles stay neutral
  - Both are off by default under Settings → Appearance → Theme Manager → Options
- Add **Unread Badges** under Interface to show the Inbox's unread count as a small dot on the tab bar and on the Inbox's Notifications and Chat tabs, and to color unread badges with your theme's accent instead of red (#1680: @icpryde, @AcornElf)
  - Compact Dot on Tab Bar, Compact Dot in Inbox (shown while modern Chat is on) and Theme Color are each off by default
- Show **Hidden & Deleted** in Apollo's own post and comment lists, so results follow your post size, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus, and open their threads like anywhere else (#1485: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Items keep their Hidden, Removed or Deleted label, removed posts keep their saved title and media, and the Posts tab has its own Compact Posts / Large Thumbnails button
- Add a **Spelling** setting under Interface → Display & Navigation: Apollo Reborn's screens now use American spelling to match Apollo, and choosing British changes the whole app's spelling to British (#1648: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Posts, comments, usernames and subreddit names keep the spelling they were written with
- Add **All+** to blend NSFW posts back into r/all by Reddit's own hot ranking, the way old Reddit's r/all showed them (#1472: @nnastasi)
  - Off by default: turn on Show NSFW in r/all under Posts & Feeds → All+; it applies to the Hot, Best and Rising sorts, and an optional NSFW boost slider moves them higher
- Make swipes on the open **iPhone Duo** follow your finger: Back within a pane, closing a thread, opening and closing the subreddit list and leaving a profile, with a forward swipe to bring a closed thread or profile back (#1656: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - With **Disable Left Swipes** on, swipe right anywhere in a pane to go Back, folded or unfolded, while galleries and carousels keep their own swipes (#1476: @nnastasi)
  - Turning Split View on or off no longer squashes post and comment text or makes the title bar jump, and sideways drags no longer open posts or start the text loupe
- Add a **draggable divider** between the feed and thread in the open iPhone Duo's landscape split view: hold the grip and drag to resize, and Apollo remembers your width (#1672: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - It snaps near ⅓, 40%, 50% and 60%; double-tap the grip to return to 50/50
- Use the **Focused feed** layout in open portrait on the iPhone Duo too, and switch layouts from feeds and threads opened in Inbox, Account and Search (#1682, #1652: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Tall images, galleries and videos now fill the Focused column instead of half its width
- Add **tabletop video controls** on the half-folded iPhone Duo: a fullscreen video moves above the fold, with large rewind, play/pause and forward buttons, a timeline, mute, Playback Speed and AirPlay below it (#1591: @nunoo)
  - It turns on by itself when you half-fold with a video open and goes back to the normal viewer when you unfold; on every device, Hold for Video Speed no longer fires when you press a video control

### Fixes

- Load **hot**, **new** and **rising** feeds, **more replies** rows and subreddit icons again on **API-Key-Free** accounts after Reddit started blocking them in early November (#1657, #1666: @DeltAndy123)
  - Installs with Use Route Updates on already picked these up; this version builds them in
- Reload a feed that failed because Reddit's rate limit was reached on **API-Key-Free** accounts once the limit resets, instead of leaving "Couldn't load posts" until you pull to refresh (#1670: @icpryde)
  - The empty list says the posts will load when the limit resets, and the Inbox sends one fewer request at launch
- Keep **API-Key-Free Mode** off after you turn it off, instead of it switching back on at the next launch; the account returns to its API key sign-in, or Apollo asks you to sign in again if that sign-in no longer works (#1627: @icpryde)

# DukeX v1.0.2 - Expanding the Xbox Experience

DukeX v1.0.2 is our biggest step yet toward preserving the full original Xbox
experience, not just the games. This release introduces the first native macOS
build, expands XB.Live integration, and brings richer community features to both
iOS and macOS.

## What's New

- Native macOS release: DukeX is now available as a Mac Catalyst desktop build
  packaged with a nested Xemu fork, pairing desktop Xemu compatibility with the
  DukeX interface.
- XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking: friends can see what you are
  playing while DukeX tracks supported playtime sessions.
- XB.Live messaging: threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread
  indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox support now live
  inside DukeX.
- XB.Live social expansion: friend requests, friend management, online presence,
  and deeper community integration are available from the Profile experience.
- Activity Feed: XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks,
  and community updates now appear in a continuously refreshed timeline.
- Controller Landscape Mode: on iOS, compatible controllers can switch DukeX
  into a controller-first browsing and launch experience.
- Expanded AirPlay and external display support: big-screen play is more
  reliable across supported display configurations.

## Improvements

- Improved achievements with Games, Apps, and Cores grouping plus updated
  artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles.
- Improved game tile spacing and cover handling across iOS and macOS.
- Improved XB.Live cloud-save sync metadata with console identity v2,
  content-hash dedupe, and server-assisted cross-console restore handling.
- Fixed achievement progress rounding so time-based achievements do not show
  100% before they are actually complete.

## Availability

- iOS: install `DukeX.v1.0.2.ipa` through StikStore, SideStore, or another
  supported sideloading workflow.
- macOS: install `DukeX.macOS.v1.0.2.dmg` by dragging DukeX to Applications.
- Hardware requirements on iOS remain Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 hardware or
  newer.
- iOS 16.0 or later is supported, with iOS 16 support remaining experimental.

## Important

DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, copyrighted
content, signing certificates, or user games. Users must provide their own
legally obtained files. DukeX is intended for legitimate emulation,
preservation, testing, and personal library use.

apps.subtitle: x86-64 PC emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS. Fathom runs x86-64 Linux programs on an iPhone or iPad by translating them to ARM64 as they execute, using FEXCore - the dynamic recompiler behind FEX-Emu - with a native SwiftUI front end.

Import a statically linked x86-64 Linux executable, open it, press Run. Fathom maps it into a guest address space, hands its instructions to FEXCore's JIT, answers its Linux syscalls, and shows you its output.

JIT requires StikDebug to attach to the process and service the executable-memory traps; Fathom asks for this automatically on launch when it is missing.

Please note: only statically linked, position-independent executables (-static-pie) run today. Dynamically linked binaries and 32-bit x86 are not supported yet, and threads are not implemented, so a guest runs single-threaded.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

## Install and test

Download `iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.6-build145.ipa` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the hash, then sign/sideload using your own coherent development main/helper profiles. Keep `MadeiraJITHelper.appex` and debugging permission; signing alone does not activate JIT. Back up saves and keep the same app identity when upgrading—uninstalling can erase local data.

Open iDeck and follow the highlighted setup step; fully close/reopen when prompted after installing Steam64. For on-device pairing use iOS27; iOS26 offers pairing-file import. Activate JIT again for each new app process.

The IPA includes the local runtime and pinned source-built open support components, **no Valve Steam client/libcef, games, accounts, maintainer profile or pairing file**. The installer acquires the client from Valve. Both source companions, relink, license/audit and inventory/checksum assets accompany this release.

## What was verified

The user reports Build144 installation can complete. Build145 passed host ordering/skip/restart/signing/VA checks, installer/rollback/privacy regressions, existing JIT integration checks and full Xcode compilation. Its separate Fresh Test version was development-signed, installed/read back and opened on an iPhone15ProMax; original iDeck was preserved. The public ad-hoc IPA was audited (1480files, no findings), and its105-input relink ran with all30TEXT section hashes matching.

The complete revised145 first-run UI, another-device sideload/JIT, new Steam login and repeated gameplay have **not** received a new acceptance result; the public IPA was not installed again after ad-hoc packaging. iPad, Bluetooth and arbitrary games are not validated by this release. Full independent-machine/offline runtime rebuilding is not claimed.

## Limits that still matter

- **Third game return may freeze Steam.** Report the first failing stage and game-cycle count.
- Steam64 does **not** enlarge the device’s virtual address space. Unsupported layouts can still fail;32-bit games/helpers may still hit separate limits. Guards remain enabled.
- The compatibility snapshot is **Steam manifest1769025840 (January22,2026), CEF126**, held to its matched components. It is not the latest Steam/Chromium and has security/compatibility limitations; future snapshots need fresh review.
- Game support remains limited. No DRM, authentication or anti-cheat bypass is provided. Never post credentials, Steam Guard data, pairing files, profiles or raw personal logs.

See [the four-step guide](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/STEAM64_SETUP.md), [Build145 evidence](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/release/BUILD145_RESULTS.md) and the bilingual README.

apps.name: LiveContainer+SideStore
apps.subtitle: Run iOS apps without actually installing them!
apps.localizedDescription: An app launcher that runs iOS apps without actually installing them. This build of LiveContainer comes with a built-in SideStore for refreshing your apps.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Commit:** [b0f53e8934df325970e9b6ff52932a43b585c424](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/commit/b0f53e8934df325970e9b6ff52932a43b585c424)
**Message:** fix build

This is a nightly release [created automatically with GitHub Actions workflow](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/actions/runs/44759628484/attempts/1).

# ⚠️This build is OUTDATED. Please use [nightly version](https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly) instead.

# LiveContainer 3.8.0

> [!Warning]
> The standalone version requires **SideStore 0.6.2+** or **AltStore 2.2.1+** for installation.
> To install LiveContainer with built-in SideStore (`LiveContainer+SideStore.ipa`), please use [Impactor](https://github.com/khcrysalis/Impactor) or [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader). See [our installation guide](https://livecontainer.github.io/docs/installation/lc_sidestore) for details.

# New Features

## Storage Management

- Added a new storage management view with a breakdown of app bundles, containers, temporary files, app group data, tweaks, and other files. (Hidden apps' size is included in "other" section until unlocked)
- Added per-app storage details, including app bundle size, container sizes, and last-used date.
- Added actions to clean temporary files and caches, including guest app caches and LiveContainer's own caches.

## Multiple LiveContainers
- Added configurable launch priority for multiple LiveContainer instances, making shared-app shortcuts choose available instances in the order you prefer. (#1367)

## Share to Apps in LiveContainer
Added a share extension to LiveContainer. When you share a URL or a file from iOS's share sheet, LiveContainer will ask which app you would like to open the URL/file in, so the old share to LiveContainer shortcut method is no longer needed. When an ipa file is shared in this way, LiveContainer will ask if you want to install it in LiveContainer or in the built-in SideStore (if installed) (#1357)

## Multitasking

- Added per-app multitask preferences. Each app can now follow the global setting, always launch in multitask mode, or avoid multitask mode. (#1208)
- Improved multitask dock behavior: the dock can be made smaller, hidden more cleanly, and has improved padding. (#1228, #1250)
- Added more multitask window animations and improved native-window scene handling.
- URL schemes and `open-url` payloads can be passed to already-running multitask apps and native windows.

## JIT
- Added StosDebug support as a JIT enabler.

## TweakLoader
You can now disable tweaks in the "Tweaks" page in LiveContainer's UI. by @SAOMDVN

# Improvements
- Added support for manually setting a container's IDFV. (#1194)
- IDFV spoofing works even when Tweakloader is not loaded.
- Reworked signing logic for tweaks and app installation, with multithreaded signing support.
- Download alerts now block tab switching while a download is in progress.
- Crash reports are shown in a sheet instead of a large alert for better performance on newer iOS versions.
- Add a "Clear Notification" button (#1388)
- Added some popular NSBonjourServices keys so apps can discover AirPlay devices and remote pairing pairable hosts in the local network. (#1417)

# Bug Fixes

- Fixed `livecontainer://open-url` dropping the deep link when launching an app from a cold start. (#1339)
- Fixed the Add to Home Screen menu failing or behaving incorrectly by replacing the SwiftUI context menu implementation. (#1209)
- Fixed a crash when opening Container Preferences if the app did not contain an `en.lproj` path. (#1239)
- Fixed apps and AltStore sources not being searchable in some cases. (#1365, #1368)
- Fixed converting a shared app back to private after aborting an install with the same bundle identifier, which could leave stale container state behind. (#1347)
- Fixed shortcuts and JIT flows getting stuck on a busy LiveContainer instance instead of using another available instance. (#1386)
- Fixed file picker not workings for some apps because Tweakloader is not loaded after enabling "Hide LiveContainer from dyld API". (#1430)
- Fixed several app launch compatibility issues on iOS 26.5 beta, and some multitask/JIT app launches. (#1300, #1310, #1329)
- Fixed multitask keyboard focus issues on iOS 17.4+, including cases where the keyboard would not appear, Passwords would immediately close, or video playback would freeze in multitask mode. (#1402, #844, #870)
- Added support for iOS 27 developer beta. (#1394, #1417, #1416)
- Fix background downloads in multitask apps (choosing "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" is required). (#1415)

# Localization

- Updated translations. Added Spanish translation by @Deci8BelioS

# Credits

Thanks to everyone who contributed code, fixes, testing, and reports for this release, including @boa-z, @ruri1208, @Project516, @yazdipour, @stossy11, and @SAOMDVN.

Great thanks to everyone who helped translate LiveContainer.

## 已知问题

- **切歌无声 / 上一首残留问题仍存在**：本版已尝试根治（原生层播放/暂停去早退、切歌意图确立后立即静音旧源、挂起后死亡播放器自愈），真机实测概率性仍可复现——后续版本继续排查

## 上游 6.2.0 移植

- 版本号与上游对齐（6.2.0+53），全量同步上游 md3Music 6.2.0：播放链路重构（本地 API 服务器新增响度参数与预热、媒体会话收敛）、依赖更新（m3_expressive、ort_dart、image、sqflite_common_ffi 等）、桌面小组件服务调整与全部上游修复
- just_audio 播放内核同步至上游版本，iOS fork 补丁（音频焦点中断转发、均衡器挂载、辅助播放器）全部保留并适配新接口

## iOS 修复

- **iOS 26 桌面小组件按钮全部无响应修复**：iOS 26 弃用了在 extension 中设置 `openAppWhenRun` 的行为（点击 intent 根本不执行）；按钮 intent 改为双 target 共享 + 新 `supportedModes` 属性。播放控制类按钮（播放/暂停、上下曲、FM 控制等）现走系统后台执行协议——**点组件直接切歌，不再跳转打开 app**
- **短暂挂起回前台后播放不了修复**：挂起会触发系统媒体服务重置，播放器实例死亡但应用状态未更新，点播放走快路径无声无错。新增前台死亡观察：播放中但进度 10 秒不动的判定为死播放器，自动重建并恢复到原进度（锁屏/切后台几分钟后回来自动恢复）
- **挂起恢复后搜索/解析全部失败修复**：挂起后本地 API 服务器工作线程死亡而监听端口残留，旧探测方式被内核代答误判「服务正常」且永不自愈；探测改为真实 HTTP 请求，回前台主动健康检查并按需重建服务
- **3D 封面系列修复**：iOS 缓存目录异常曾导致推理链路完全静默失败（不推理也无提示），失败原因现已对用户可见；脏缓存条目（索引在、文件丢）被误判为「设备不支持 shader」导致全进程降级多层视差的问题修复——缓存命中增加完整性校验，缺失自动重新推理
- **歌词画中画修复**：双行布局在较大字号下上下顶边裁切（行距超界），改为按剩余空间三等分居中——任何字号、单双行都完整居中
- **显示大小**：调整后未点「保留」就杀后台，不再把未确认档位带进下次启动（确认前仅内存预览，点「保留」才落盘）；iOS 隐藏「硬件解码播放」入口（iOS 播放器恒为系统级硬解，无对应开关可做）
- CI 构建修复：恢复 Rust 静态库编译产物（上游同步时被覆盖丢失导致 iOS 构建失败）

## 其它

- 签名与小组件兼容说明：App Group 兼容**目前仅支持 [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader)**（电脑签）；SideStore/AltStore 手机签后小组件显示「无法加载」是其签名流程丢弃 App Group 权限所致，主应用功能不受影响

未签名 IPA：下载后自行签名安装（推荐 [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader)，免费 Apple ID 签名即可）。

- `MD3Music-unsigned.ipa`：标准版（无 3D 封面，推荐）
- `MD3Music-3D-unsigned.ipa`：含 3D 封面支持版（内置 Depth Anything V2 深度模型与 MI-GAN 修补模型，设置中开启 3D 封面即可；生成失败时自动回退平面封面，包体约 +40MB）

仅供学习交流，请勿用于商业用途！详见[免责声明](https://github.com/EPXiaohua/MD3Music-iOS/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md)。如条件允许请支持原作者项目：[zzyoxml/md3Music](https://github.com/zzyoxml/md3Music/)。

apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight YouTube client with SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, and up to 1080p playback. No ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.localizedDescription: An independently maintained iOS/iPadOS fork of NeoStation with a gamepad-friendly, console-style game library and embedded Libretro cores, MeloNX, Dolphin, ARMSX2 and RPCS3 runtimes, JIT workflows and support for user-supplied firmware, keys and BIOS.

versions.localizedDescription:
# RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

## 🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

- **Assassin’s Creed:** audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
- Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to **Vulkan/MoltenVK**.
- Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
- **Black Ops II:** corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
- **Black Ops II:** earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
- Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
- **Assassin’s Creed:** corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
- Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
- **God of War III:** removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
- **God of War III v1.00:** the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
- **Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6:** corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
- Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
- More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
- Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
- Repositioned the **Menu** and **Performance** buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
- Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

## 🎨 Skins and touch controls

- Added **GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket** skins.
- Added **Pocket — Original** variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
- Added **Switch Pocket**, available through **Skins in the Switch playlist menu**.
- Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
- Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
- Corrected **rectangular press highlights**, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
- GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.
- Bundled skin updates now refresh older installed copies while preserving your selections.
- Restored access to **Skins from the PS2 playlist**.
- Corrected the return from the MeloNX in-game menu so skin buttons and sticks regain input immediately.
- Improved game-screen framing inside Pocket skins, including rounded corners.
- Refined pressed-button visuals so controls sink into their housings rather than simply turning gray.
- Dolphin and PS2 floating session buttons no longer cover skin controls when the skin provides its own Menu button.

## 🏆 RetroAchievements

- Centralized sign-in and **Hardcore** settings.
- Corrected repeated sign-outs, credential persistence and migration of older accounts.
- Improved session ownership of notifications and progress, including external-display presentation.
- Achievement text follows the app language when the required Apple translation features are available.
- Improved game recognition, including **CHD and CSO**, with consistent identification in the library and during play.
- Clearer messages distinguish an unrecognized game from an unreadable file.

## 🧩 Cheats & Enhancements

- A unified **Cheats & Enhancements** page for each game.
- Access to compatible frame-rate, aspect-ratio, graphics and other available game patches.
- Improved activation, deactivation and restoration of original settings.
- **Corrected unintended Switch cheat activation** when the enable list was missing.
- Cheat state remains usable after the app container moves.
- RewindBox-generated cheat files now contain only the selected programs.

## 📚 Library, artwork and manuals

- Reworked 3D cases with more faithful proportions, relief, spines and backs.
- Editable back covers and nondestructive image correction.
- Artwork matching using the ROM’s actual game identifier.
- More reliable batch scraping with better preservation of existing media.
- Improved **French cover and manual** lookup with additional sources.
- Improved scan viewing and zoom.
- Lighter Switch discovery avoids reading entire game files on the main thread.

## ✨ Interface and navigation

- New **RewindBox Glacier** style with a reversible preset.
- Bundled offline system artwork.
- Corrections to margins, obscured titles, icon sizes and carousels.
- Corrections to system bubbles and the “⋯” menu.
- An **icons-only main navigation bar**, while retaining accessible names for VoiceOver.

## 🧪 Experimental renderer

- Added an **optional native Metal 4 renderer for RPCS3**. Vulkan/MoltenVK remains available and the selected renderer is preserved.

## Testing and known limits

The downloaded Build 721 IPA passed the recorded offline package, source/component identity and delivery checks. RPCS3 Core 919. Fresh Flutter, native and delivery-contract checks were executed for this delivery. The downloaded file matches the original private delivery byte for byte.

Automated tests and desktop benchmarks do not establish iPhone FPS, audio or gameplay improvements. The complete package has not been gameplay-validated on a physical iPhone. First-use shader compilation and game-specific issues may remain. Cheats and achievement support depend on the game, version and engine.

Long Hogwarts Legacy pauses and residual BO2 performance problems remain under investigation. This build retains automatic BO2/God of War III comparison windows; their removal belongs to a later build and is not included here.

Some faithful Pocket layouts have small touch targets or Dynamic Island overlap. Switch Pocket’s HOME and Capture controls are unavailable in this engine; MeloNX does not lock session orientation through the skin. The MeloNX Metal binary-archive prototype, Switch 2 experiment and RPCS3 comparison-only Cores are not included.

## Download and installation

**IPA:** [RewindBox-0.0.11.ipa](https://github.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/releases/download/0.0.11/RewindBox-0.0.11.ipa)

**SideStore / AltStore Classic source:** [source.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TarbleFR/RewindBox/Claude/source.json)

- Requires **iOS 18.0 or later**.
- Re-sign with SideStore, AltStore Classic or your usual compatible sideloading tool. This is not a notarized AltStore PAL package or a directly installable Apple distribution build.
- Public release: **0.0.11**. IPA metadata remains **0.0.8, Build 721**; the source preserves those exact values and uses `marketingVersion` to display 0.0.11.
- Size: **267,033,667 bytes**.
- SHA-256: `bc640a83a01de8a623c16fb0b5977edf16ac6010b61c9c2489ae334d3db3c0d7`.

No firmware, keys, BIOS or game files are bundled.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 谢谢大家
谢谢每一位在玩、在报 bug、在评论区出主意的朋友，是大家的支持让这个重制版一路更新到现在。

这个重制版一开始只是我用公司给的无限 token，自己做着自己玩的；没想到承蒙大家喜爱，被大家无私地越传越广。**这个游戏属于每一位喜欢大富翁4的玩家：永远不收任何费用，也不做任何商业用途，大家尽管拿去玩就好。**

**1.3 的新地图正在制作中**，工作量比较大，下一个版本要隔比较长的一段时间才会发布。这段时间里，1.2.4 就是大家的主力版本：

- **遇到 bug 或小问题**：可以直接在 [Issues](https://github.com/iam567/rich4-renew-app/issues) 提交，也可以在 B 站 UP 主 **TrustBox**、**阿姆西_MC** 发布的大富翁4 重制版视频下面留言。各个评论区我都会看，能修的一定会修。
- **在线更新很慢或失败**：这个我暂时没办法解决。在国内提供下载需要办理备案，我个人没办法申请，所以国内的朋友在线更新时请先开代理；或者直接下载这个页面的安装包覆盖安装，效果一样，存档也会保留。

再次感谢大家，我们 1.3 见！

> **1.2.4 是 1.2 之后几个小版本的合集，这次最大的新功能是「排行榜」。** 已经装了 1.2.x 的玩家，在游戏里在线更新就能升到 1.2.4，不用重新下载；新玩家、或者在线更新一直不成功的，直接下载下面的安装包覆盖安装就行，存档、设置都会保留（保险起见，可以先在「游戏设置 → 存档备份」导出一份）。

## v1.2.4 更新内容

- **新增：排行榜。** 标题画面「图鉴」下面多了「排行榜」按钮：
  - 四个榜：最富榜（通关时资产最多）、最快榜（通关用时最短）、最狠榜、最惨榜；每张地图、每个难度各自排名，显示前 50 名，自己的最好成绩固定在最下面。
  - 「开始游戏」里 1 个玩家打 3 个电脑、让所有电脑破产，就可能上榜。打进前 50 名会跳出「新纪录」：填名字，选地区（各省、香港、澳门、台湾，海外可以再选国家），还可以留一个社交账号（抖音、B站、YouTube 等，最多 16 个字），显示在排行榜上让大家来找你挑战。上榜后名字、地区和账号都不能再修改。
  - 最狠榜和最惨榜怎么算分，排行榜里按「怎么算分」可以看。
  - 为了公平：成绩会经过核对，改过的数据上不了榜；读过存档的局、开局时没有连网的局、玩家自制的地图都不能上榜。
- **新增：自建地图可以盖「企业大楼」。** 编辑器「格子」页多了保险公司、电脑公司、加油站、汽车公司、航空公司、建设公司，和原版地图一样：
  - 停在别人当董事长的企业要付费：保险费、电脑费、加油费、修车费，航空公司是出国观光的旅游费，建设公司是帮你的地加盖一层的工程费。
  - 自己是最大股东时停下有好处：保险公司免费加保险，建设公司免费帮你加盖。
  - 每座企业大楼占地 2×2 格，要放在两格相连的普通路旁边；每座都是这张地图的一支股票，在「股票」里可以改名。
  - 可以选建筑风格：保险公司 5 种（台湾、日本、星际、恐龙、武侠），电脑公司 2 种，其他各 1 种。
- 新增：自建地图的「特殊规则」可以设「道具礼物箱」：路上放 1 个（原版）、5 个、10 个或 15 个礼物箱，每个月月初全部换到新位置，被捡走的也补回来。不放道具店格子，就能做出全靠捡道具、踩卡片格的道具战地图。
- 修正：部分安卓手机的「有新版本」窗口里，更新说明太长时把「更新」按钮挤到屏幕外，只能删掉游戏重新下载；游戏里其他提示窗口也一起修好了。

## 1.2 到 1.2.4 之间的小版本（这些都已通过游戏内更新发布过，1.2.4 全部包含）

### v1.2.3（2026-11-16，游戏内更新）
- **「电脑地狱」难度改版**（只改地狱，简单、中等、困难都不变）：
  - 遥控骰子、路障等道具全场按人数限量（4 人局每种只有 4 个），用掉才回到商店；研究所做的道具不能卖回商店。
  - 均富卡、均贫卡、恶魔卡、冬眠卡、红卡、黑卡全场各只有 1 张；能整人和防身的卡（陷害、嫁祸、查税、免费、免罪等）全场按人数，每人每种最多 1 张。
  - 宝箱改为随机 100～500 点；股票不再一路连涨或连跌，更难猜。
  - 地狱电脑更凶：集中对付玩家，进魔法屋专挑让玩家卖光卡片、卖光道具、住院、坐牢的魔法；会用遥控骰子抢土地公等好神，附身土地公后用乌龟卡一格一格踩玩家的地。
  - 派对模式里有旧版本的玩家一起玩时，按旧规则进行。
- 新增：游戏中屏幕保持常亮。围观、AI 托管或等别人走的时候，手机不会再自动锁屏；回到标题画面后恢复正常。
- 新增：「创作乐园」的地图页可以「直接玩」，不用先下载到「我的地图」。「下载到我的地图」现在只是下载，不会再打开地图编辑器。
- 「创作乐园」默认按「最多花」排序，顺序改为：最多花、最热门、最新。
- 围观或进入房间连线时，多了「不看了」「取消」按钮，网络不好时不用一直等。
- 修正：「游戏大厅」里房间的「围观」「加入」按钮被挤到卡片外面或掉到头像下面。
- 修正：手机横屏时，「自建地图」窗口的「返回」、编辑器「选单」里的「存档并离开」等按钮跑到屏幕外，点不到也退不出来；现在所有自建地图的窗口都会缩放到屏幕里。横屏时「更新日志」底部的按钮也看得到了。
- 修正：自建地图里用简体字、日文等起的地块、设施名字，在游戏里显示成方框（例如「水□广□」）；现在名字照原样显示，超过 7 个字也不会被截断。
- 修正：「新建地图」窗口的样子显示错乱（变成黄色椭圆）。
- 修正：转盘（例如电脑住进你的旅馆时）点得太快，转盘的音效可能一直响、关不掉。
- 修正拍卖卡「次次流拍」：电脑出价的上限以前按地价算，盖满（5 级）的地和设施底价比上限还高，电脑永远不出价。现在上限跟着底价走，盖了房子的地也拍得出去。和旧版本一起联机时按旧规则进行。

### v1.2.2（2026-11-15，游戏内更新，紧急修复）
- **紧急修复 1.2.1 更新带来的问题：派对模式建好房间后，「开始游戏」和「解散房间」按钮点不到，只能聊天，也退不出房间。现在都恢复正常了。**
- **新增「版本选择」：点标题画面右下角的版本号，或者「更新日志」里的「检查更新」，可以手动检查更新，切换到 1.2.2 以后的任何一个版本（存档会保留）。以后小更新万一有问题，可以先退回稳定的版本继续玩，修好后再更新回来；退回后不会一直提醒更新，等有更新的版本才会再提醒。**
- 派对模式不再强制更新：1.2.x 的不同小版本可以进同一个房间一起玩（按房间里最旧的版本规则进行）。
- 修正：用自建地图玩的一局，关掉游戏后再读存档（包括自动存档）会提示「读取存档失败：Load failed」。现在存档里会带上这张地图；之前的存档只要地图还在「我的地图」里、路没有改过，也能读出来。存档列表里显示地图的名字，不再是「地图 5000」。
- 局域网联机：手机上写明了手机不能开房间，要用 Windows 或 Mac 版的游戏开房，手机在这里加入。
- 派对模式上方的在线人数，在窄屏手机上会分两行显示，不再超出框外。

### v1.2.1（2026-11-14，游戏内更新）
- **派对模式新玩法「小游戏捣乱」：有人玩小游戏时，其他玩家和观众都能看到他的画面，还能点画面给他捣乱——企鹅挖宝在宝物亮出来时放假宝物、开挖后在冰面画红点；射气球往屏幕上扔番茄挡视线；喜从天降从上面丢炸弹（接到会晕一下，游戏不会结束）。每人 2 秒一次，被捣乱的人会看到是谁干的。在「追加玩法」里可以关掉（默认开，只在回合制）。**
- 派对模式：等别人回合的时候，屏幕上方会显示他刚刚买卖了什么（买进、卖出哪支股票多少股，开了几倍杠杆，买了什么道具、卡片）。
- 派对模式（即时制）围观：可以用「◀ 视角 ▶」选择跟着哪位玩家看；跟着的人破产后，视角自动切到下一位还在玩的人。
- 自建地图新增「强制修复」：检查出问题时点一下，系统自动把能修的都修好（接上断开的路、把路的尽头接回路上、放医院、监狱、银行、补地块、挪开压住路的建筑……），改了什么会一条条列出来，不满意可以「撤销」。
- 自建地图：分几笔画的路、挨着的路尽头会自动接上；斜路和直路在拐角处不会再多出一个接不上的格子；不是正方形的地图，试玩时小地图位置对得上，画面也能拖到底。

versions.localizedDescription:
# Simple Live v1.13.3 更新速览

发布日期：2026-10-25

本版主题：发热优化、Windows 退出修复、桌面端快捷键中文输入法适配、B站弹幕缺失修复与虎牙 4K 断流调查结论。2026-11-01 追加全屏四角时钟（#160），2026-11-02 追加音量增强与音量手势修复（#161），2026-11-03 修复抖音部分房间登录墙导致进不去、关注页刷不出，2026-11-08 追加 iOS 系统画中画、取消关注不再触发全量刷新（#163）与 WebDAV 恢复 500 根因修复（#164）。

经过19次构建，终于解决了，连media_kit都没解决的iOS PIP问题，在一个PR中，获得了思路，经过一些修复，与我们项目实现了兼容。

在此，感谢各位提供日志的用户：@laobai95 等等多位用户（请在群内提供git用户名）。
## 省电模式（新增，默认关闭）

- 针对安卓端观看时发热严重的反馈，新增一键「省电模式」（设置 → 直播间设置 → 播放器，置于首位）：视频缩放降档（均衡 → bilinear、画质 → spline36）、弹幕限 60 帧、关闭弹幕描边、放宽安卓播放检测频率、多开上限 4 个且压至最低清晰度。
- 默认关闭，关闭时所有行为与 v1.13.2 完全一致；打开后进入下一个直播间生效。全端开关一致可见（iOS 上为弹幕部分生效）。

## 弹幕渲染降耗

- 弹幕描边开关（默认开）：关闭后每条弹幕少一次整段文本绘制，弹幕越密越省。
- 帧率上限（默认跟随屏幕）：高刷屏可限 60 帧，视觉无差异、GPU 负担约减半。
- 修复「描边宽度」设置从未生效的问题（渲染侧此前硬编码为 2）。
- 弹幕层透明度改为逐条并入颜色 alpha，去掉整层离屏合成（视觉不变）。

## 性能与修复

- 高热房间 CPU：屏蔽词正则从「每条消息每个词重新编译」改为编译一次缓存，消息量越大收益越明显。
- Windows 退出修复：关闭应用时偶发的「快速异常检测失败」fast-fail 弹窗与进程挂死；本地 fork media_kit_video Windows 部分，纹理与 mpv render context 释放改为同步等待，退出时等待 mpv 关停。
- 关闭窗口弹「Unknown Hard Error」：装有搜狗输入法等第三方输入法的电脑，每次关闭都会弹出系统错误（出错模块 `SogouPY.ime`）；现退出时跳过第三方模块的卸载回调，不再弹窗。

## 桌面端快捷键（Windows / macOS / Linux）

- 中文输入法下 F、R、空格等单键快捷键可直接使用，无需先切英文；输入框内照常打中文。
- 带 Ctrl / Alt / Win（macOS 为 Cmd / Ctrl / Option）的组合键不再被拦截，修复 macOS 直播间内 Cmd+Q 无法退出等问题；macOS / Linux 补上空格键播放/暂停；长按只触发一次。

## B站弹幕缺失修复（#150）

- B站对弹幕接口的登录态风控（账号被标记后带 cookie 请求被拒）导致弹幕缺失、换号才能恢复；现登录态请求失败时自动回退未登录获取 token，以游客身份连接弹幕。
- 回退不粘连：每次进房先走登录态，风控解除后自动恢复；清晰度与账号其他功能不受影响（取流仍走登录态）。

## 全屏四角时钟（新增，#160，2026-11-01 追加）

- 全屏直播画面四角（左上/右上/左下/右下）常驻显示当前时间（HH:mm），不随控制栏隐藏；仅全屏显示，默认关闭、右上角，入口在 直播间设置 → 四角时钟。
- 时钟层不拦截触摸，滑动手势不受影响；组件自管定时器、关闭时零开销。TV 端同版合入同款功能。

## 音量增强与音量手势修复（#161，2026-11-02 追加）

- 新增「音量增强」开关（默认关，直播间设置 → 播放器 → 音量）：开启后音量上限 0–300%，超过 100% 为播放器软件增益（最高 ×3.0），不动系统音量；关闭时全部音量入口回到 0–100，与旧版一致。
- 音量弹窗（底栏音量图标，移动端本版起也开放）：滑条 + 预设 0/50/100/200/300（关=0/50/100），增益区显示倍率。
- 修复安卓快速上下滑调音量「实际没有反应」：终值落地不再被丢弃，快速滑动必生效。
- 纯增益在音源响度大时可能破音，调回 200% 以内即可。TV 端同版合入音量控制。

## 虎牙 4K 断流调查结论（#156，2026-10-31）

- 虎牙已将 4K / 4K HDR 设为 VIP 专属画质（登录网页端画质列表实测标注）。非 VIP 账号拉 4K 会被 CDN 随机拒绝（`Failed to open`）或限速至不可用带宽，表现为断流卡顿；与客户端参数、登录态、IP 均无关，客户端无解。
- 2K 及以下不受影响，追求流畅建议选 2K；调查中试行的参数修改已验证无效并撤回。
- TV 端结论相同；TV 版本另有轮播列表、标签批量管理与全屏四角时钟。

## 抖音登录墙房间进不去修复（2026-11-03 追加）

- 部分抖音房间（如「赛雷三分钟」）App 内报 room 为空进不去、关注页刷不出，但直链导入外部播放器能播。根因是匿名访问被 web 端按房间维度下发扫码登录墙（`enter_mode=1`、不下发 room），换 ttwid / 移动端 UA 均无效。
- 新增移动端 reflow 匿名取房：凭登录墙响应里仍可匿名拿到的主播 `sec_user_id`，请求 reflow 接口（无需 Cookie 与签名）取回真实房间与流地址，在 API 与 HTML 两条路径都做兜底；关注页状态判断同步修复。
- 实网验证 4 档画质真实可播、`getLiveStatus` 正常。TV 端共享核心库同步生效。

## iOS 系统画中画（新增，2026-11-08 追加）

- iOS 端新增系统级小窗（画中画，要求 iOS 15+）：直播画面悬浮于桌面与其他应用之上，后台持续观看；采用 AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer 路线，mpv 渲染帧零拷贝桥接进系统小窗。
- 「后台保持画面」开关（设置 → 播放设置 → iOS 小窗，默认开）：开启后进小窗先停播重建管线至软解码+软渲染（纯 CPU，不依赖后台 GPU 权限），切后台画面持续显示，实测连续 76 秒 30fps 零丢帧；关闭为即显省电路线，秒开，切后台画面停住、声音正常。
- 返回 App 自动关闭小窗并恢复应用内播放；小窗内可暂停/恢复播放，与 App 内状态同步。
- 已知说明：重建路线进小窗有 1~2 秒重连空窗；后台持续画面耗电略增，部分设备后台渲染表现不一致，可按实测用开关选择；其他平台（Android 系统小窗、TV）不受本项影响。

## 取消关注不再触发全量刷新（#163，2026-11-08 追加）

- 清理关注列表时，每次取消关注都会触发**全部**关注的开播状态刷新（上百关注等于上百次请求），容易触发平台风控。
- 现取消关注仅本地移除（标签归属同步清理），不再发起任何网络请求；开播状态按原有的定时刷新 / 手动刷新节奏更新。

## WebDAV 恢复 500 根因修复（#164，2026-11-08 追加）

- 「能上传、不能恢复」的根因确认：Alist 等网关把恢复（GET）请求代理转发到阿里云盘 OSS 签名直链时，应用携带的多余 `Content-Type: text/xml` 头被透传参与签名计算，与直链签名不一致（`SignatureDoesNotMatch`），403 被转成 500 返回。
- 修复：GET 请求不再携带该头（PROPFIND 所需的 XML Content-Type 由组件按规范自行设置，不受影响）。
- 同步失败时的报错增强：附带请求方法、URL、状态码与服务器响应体摘要（300 字符），便于定位服务端问题。

## 设置页重排

- 我的-设置入口：直播设置、弹幕设置、多开设置提前聚拢（外观 → 主页 → 直播 → 弹幕 → 多开 → 播放页 → 关注 → 定时 → 其他）。
- 直播设置：省电模式置顶；移动端后台播放相关项并入「直播间」段；实时字幕（实验）移至末尾。
- 弹幕设置拆为屏蔽 / 显示 / 重点动态 / 过滤与延迟四段，屏蔽保持第一。

- Android 和 iOS 支持通过相机或相册扫描 VRChat 链接，图片包含多个二维码时可选择识别结果。
- 支持扫码审批 VRChat 设备登录，展示请求时间和来源地区；Android 新增扫一扫桌面快捷方式。

- 好友动态新增名字和模型变更记录，并提供独立的模型筛选分类。

## 优化

- 群组房间支持邀请自己，世界详情加载来源房间，展开的房间卡片可打开房主主页。
- 资料编辑适配 VRChat 新接口，保存简介、社交链接和语言后同步刷新状态。

## 修复

- 后台登录会话失效时自动恢复，避免好友与动态更新长期中断。
- 修复玩家批量清理在列表刚加载完时点击无响应，以及登录续期后剩余请求中断的问题；避免迟到的续期通知覆盖已成功的语音开关状态。
- 修复 Android 大型统计快照读取、系统文件选择器导入和导出文件句柄释放问题。
- 应用内更新遇到包名或签名不匹配的 APK 时停止更新，避免继续换源重试。
- 修复 Windows 渐进背景模糊导致的卡死、群组代表状态跨资料页不同步，以及模型列表的平台支持标记错误。

****************

## New Features

- Scan VRChat links with the camera or from photos on Android and iOS, and choose a result when an image contains multiple QR codes.
- Approve VRChat device sign-ins by scanning a code, with the request time and source region shown; Android also adds a launcher shortcut to the scanner.

- In-app updates stop when an APK has a mismatched package name or signature instead of retrying other mirrors.
- Fixed Windows freezes caused by progressive backdrop blur, group representation falling out of sync across profiles, and incorrect platform-support indicators in avatar lists.

apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. Browse other apps' containers, edit plists, hex and SQLite databases, and back up, restore or clear app data without a jailbreak or kernel exploit.

versions.localizedDescription:

> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

## New

- **Import Apps Manager backups** ([#19](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/19)): **Apps** → tap the app → **Import as Backup…** now accepts `.adbk` files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
  - Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
  - If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
  - Opening an `.adbk` from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

## Fixed

- **Files another app is using:** deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
- **Databases in use stay intact:** an app's database comes with `-wal` and `-shm` files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the `-wal` file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its `-wal`, `-shm` and `-journal` files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
- **Deleting or importing several files at once:** each database is handled before its `-wal` and `-shm` files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

versions.localizedDescription:
## WQGuard v1.3.6 (Build 27)

### Highlights / 更新摘要

#### 1. Engine 2 Real-World IPA ZIP Compatibility Fix (Issue #2)
Resolved two real-world IPA scanning failures reported in [Issue #2](https://github.com/Kianuni/WQGuard/issues/2) while keeping strict archive integrity and anti-tampering checks enforced:
- **Streaming `GPFlag` bit-3 (`0x0008`) without trailing Data Descriptor**: App Store / IPA repackagers frequently keep bit 3 set in Local File Headers even after populating Central Directory sizes and CRCs without emitting a trailing Data Descriptor (`descLen == 0`). `NativeZIPArchiveReader` now supports `descLen == 0` alongside 12/16/20/24-byte descriptors while continuing to reject contradictory non-zero Local Header bit-3 fields (`corruptHeader`).
- **Deflated empty directories & NUL alignment padding**: Added support for `method == 8` empty directory entries (`uncompSize == 0`, `compSize <= 16`) and up to 64 KB of `0x00` alignment padding between entries.
- **Uncompacted `.appex` / orphan local header isolation (`isOrphanLocalEntry`)**: Superseded or unreferenced `0x04034b50` local headers in archive gaps are isolated from the primary bundle lookup, `hasArchiveMobileProvision`, and Pass 1/Pass 2 scans, yet any unreferenced Mach-O or `.dylib` payloads remain audited in **Pass 2b** and flag `Unreferenced ZIP Local Header` seal tampering on otherwise Apple-signed packages.
- **iOS `/var` vs `/private/var` Zip Slip false-positive elimination**: Lexical path standardization (`lexicalStandardizedPath`, introduced in `v1.3.4+` and verified end-to-end in `v1.3.6`) prevents iOS sandbox `/private/var` symlink differences from triggering false Zip Slip errors on valid entries (e.g., `Payload/Stremio.app/de.lproj/`).

#### 2. Strict Concurrency Cleanup in `MachOParser`
- Eliminated the remaining `#SendableClosureCaptures` warnings in `Sources/WQGuardCore/MachO/MachOParser.swift` by capturing immutable chunk slices (`immutableChunks`) and collecting parallel scan outputs through an `@unchecked Sendable` result box (`ChunkResultsBox`).

---

### Verification & Checksums / 验证与校验

- **XCTest Suite (`-strict-concurrency=complete`)**: **50 suites / 1,020 tests passed**, 0 failures, 0 skipped, **0 warnings in `Sources/WQGuardCore`**
- **CLI Self-Audit**: `wqguard-cli --ipa WQGuard_v1.3.6.ipa --format json` → `"riskTier" : "KNOWN_TOOL"`, exit code `0`
- **`WQGuard_v1.3.6.ipa`** (`2,788,591` bytes / `2.7M`)
  - **SHA-256**: `1a85d5d4ac1cd9fafbd0c9d92bbd3c85793878465216efaefab00702b498806f`

### Release Assets / 发布附件

versions.localizedDescription:
显示版本 **0.5**，构建 **1**；内部发布修订 **0.5.0**。

这个版本的主题是「找得到、看得懂、拿得走」：

- **全局文件搜索**：跨 App 搜索用户文件，结果边扫边出；支持文件名 / 相对路径 / App 名、类型与最小大小筛选、路径 / 大小 / 最新排序。结果可原地预览或打开所在目录，扫描中可取消。
- **空间变化**：按「较上次 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天」比较，按增长排序并显示合计占用与净变化；新增全部 App 合计趋势图，单 App 详情保留当前大小、较上次、近 7 天与扫描历史。
- **文件审计与导出**：大文件 / 重复文件按 App 分组，重复项经 SHA-256 确认；清理时每个 App 至少保留一份，删除进入空间透镜回收站。导出中心可分享或存储到「文件」，目标写入完成才记成功，取消 / 失败会清理临时目录。
- **安全与一致性**：跨 App 的相同文件不再被当成可互相替代；重复清理不能选中某个 App 的最后一份；上次中断的导出在重开后显示「已中断」；清理 14 个无用本地化 key，中英文 813 个 key 对齐。
- **界面**：修复空间变化页底部被悬浮 Tab Bar 遮挡；补充全局搜索、空间趋势、导出选择面板的中英文文案。

验证：23 个本地测试程序、9 条模拟器 UI 流程、Debug 模拟器与 Release arm64 构建、`xcodebuild analyze` 全部通过，编译警告 0 条。

已知边界：本轮 IPA 未签名，未在真机安装；超大 App 的冷扫描耗时、App Group 签名、分享 / 存储到「文件」以及强制中断场景仍需真机验收。空间趋势样本不足时显示「—」，这是预期行为。

**遇到问题或有建议，欢迎到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/hseons/WQManager/issues) 提出**。请尽量附上系统版本、App 名称、复现步骤和截图；崩溃日志可配合附件中的 dSYM 定位。

附件为**未签名 IPA**、SHA-256 和 dSYM，请按项目说明保留 App Group 权限重新签名后安装。
